observed_oracle.scope: Retrospective sensitivity on fixed video model only. An oracle for checkpoint leader does not know its second rider, corner or finishing order. Not a forecast or accuracy bound.

coverage.hit_definition: Correct ordered three among displayed tickets. Full current probabilities across 287 retrospective races; conditional order given actual pair used solely post-hoc to diagnose.

budget_decomposition.classification: Retrospective attribution after fit, not independent candidate selection. Hold each exact first/second pair ticket count as originally budgeted.
